pages.text:
今天是幼儿园的家长日！一大早，Sam 爸爸就牵着咘咘的手走进幼儿园大门。咘咘蹦蹦跳跳的，两只耳朵都竖得高高的。
「爸爸今天一整天都陪你！」
「耶！」咘咘开心得快要飞起来。
pages.text_en:
Today is Family Day at kindergarten! Early in the morning, Sam Dad held Bubu's hand as they walked through the school gate. Bubu bounced along, both ears standing tall.
"Daddy's staying with you all day today!"
"Yay!" Bubu was so happy she could almost fly.

pages.text:
NOMI 骑在爸爸的背包上，探出小脑袋东张西望。NONO 飞在前面，红色的翅膀在晨光里闪闪发亮。
「好多小朋友！」NOMI 的眼睛亮晶晶的。
「叽叽！家长日最热闹了！」NONO 开心地绕了一圈。
pages.text_en:
NOMI rode on Dad's backpack, poking her head out curiously. NONO flew ahead, red wings glinting in the morning light.
"So many kids!" NOMI's eyes sparkled.
"Chirp! Family Day is the best!" NONO circled happily.

pages.text:
教室里，桌上摆满了好吃的早餐。咘咘和爸爸面对面坐着，一起吃小馒头、喝牛奶。
咘咘举起一个小馒头递给爸爸：「爸爸吃这个，这个最好吃！」
爸爸笑着接过来：「谢谢咘咘，爸爸好幸福。」
pages.text_en:
In the classroom, the table was full of yummy breakfast food. Bubu and Dad sat facing each other, sharing little buns and milk.
Bubu held up a bun for Dad: "Daddy try this one, it's the best!"
Dad smiled and took it: "Thank you, Bubu. Daddy is so happy."

pages.text:
吃完早餐，老师说有一个特别的惊喜！所有小朋友和家长都被请到操场上。
咘咘拉着爸爸的手，好奇地张大了眼睛：「什么惊喜呀？」
pages.text_en:
After breakfast, the teacher said there was a special surprise! All the kids and parents were invited to the playground.
Bubu held Dad's hand, her eyes wide with curiosity: "What surprise?"

pages.text:
突然，教室门打开了——一群恐龙冲了出来！
「吼——！」
大恐龙、小恐龙，绿色的、橙色的、紫色的，摇着大尾巴，摆着小爪子，一摇一摆地走到小朋友们面前。
咘咘惊得嘴巴张成了一个圆：「恐——恐龙！」
pages.text_en:
Suddenly, the door burst open — a group of dinosaurs charged out!
"ROAR!"
Big ones, small ones, green, orange, purple — swinging their tails, waving their claws, waddling toward the children.
Bubu's mouth dropped open: "D-dinosaurs!"

pages.text:
可是等等……那个绿色的大恐龙好像有点眼熟？
恐龙弯下腰，冲咘咘挥挥爪子：「咘咘，是我呀！」
「啊！是喵喵老师！」咘咘认出来了，笑得前仰后合，「喵喵老师变成恐龙啦！」
pages.text_en:
But wait... that big green dinosaur looked kind of familiar?
The dinosaur bent down and waved at Bubu: "Bubu, it's me!"
"Ah! It's Teacher Miaomiao!" Bubu recognized her and burst out laughing. "Teacher Miaomiao turned into a dinosaur!"

pages.text:
恐龙老师们排成一排，跳起了搞笑的恐龙舞！大尾巴甩来甩去，小爪子一上一下。
所有小朋友都笑疯了，家长们也忍不住鼓掌。NOMI 笑得从背包上差点滚下来，NONO 在空中笑得打转转。
pages.text_en:
The dinosaur teachers lined up and did a funny dinosaur dance! Big tails swinging, little claws going up and down.
All the kids laughed like crazy, and the parents couldn't help but clap. NOMI laughed so hard she almost fell off the backpack, and NONO spun in circles giggling in the air.

pages.text:
接下来，大家手拉手围成一个大圆圈，跟着音乐一起跳舞！
咘咘一手拉着爸爸，一手拉着旁边的小朋友，踩着节拍转圈圈。
「转圈圈！转圈圈！」咘咘的粉裙子像一朵小花一样旋转。
pages.text_en:
Next, everyone held hands in a big circle and danced to the music!
Bubu held Dad's hand on one side and her classmate's on the other, spinning to the beat.
"Spin spin spin!" Bubu's pink dress twirled like a little flower.

pages.text:
「砰！」天空中突然炸开了五颜六色的彩带！红的、蓝的、金的，像下了一场彩色的雨。
「哇——好漂亮！」咘咘仰着头，伸出小手去接飘落的彩带。
一根金色的彩带正好落在NONO头上，把他变成了一只「金色小鸟」。
pages.text_en:
"Pop!" Colorful streamers burst into the sky! Red, blue, gold — like a rainbow rain.
"Wow — so pretty!" Bubu looked up, stretching out her hands to catch the falling ribbons.
A golden streamer landed right on NONO's head, turning him into a "golden bird."

pages.text:
最好玩的来了——操场上铺开了一大块彩色布条！红橙黄绿蓝，像一条彩虹铺在地上。
老师说：「小朋友们，爬过彩虹就是小勇士！」
咘咘深吸一口气，趴下来，小手小脚并用，开始往前爬。
pages.text_en:
The best part was next — a huge colorful fabric strip spread across the playground! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue — like a rainbow on the ground.
The teacher said: "Kids, crawl across the rainbow and you're a little hero!"
Bubu took a deep breath, got down on all fours, and started crawling.

pages.text:
咘咘爬得又快又稳！小手抓着布条，膝盖一步一步往前挪。
爸爸在旁边拍手：「咘咘加油！你好棒！」
NOMI 在终点举着小旗子：「快到了快到了！」
最后，咘咘一个翻身，到达终点！「我做到啦！」
pages.text_en:
Bubu crawled fast and steady! Her little hands gripped the fabric as her knees moved step by step.
Dad clapped beside her: "Go Bubu! You're amazing!"
NOMI waved a little flag at the finish line: "Almost there!"
Finally, Bubu tumbled across the finish. "I did it!"

pages.text:
活动结束了。喵喵老师走过来，手里拿着两个闪闪发亮的恐龙贴纸。
「咘咘今天表现特别棒！这是你的恐龙棒棒贴！」
咘咘小心翼翼地接过来，眼睛亮得像星星：「两个！有两个恐龙！」
pages.text_en:
The activities were over. Teacher Miaomiao came over with two shiny dinosaur stickers in her hand.
"Bubu, you did so well today! Here are your dinosaur stickers!"
Bubu carefully took them, her eyes shining like stars: "Two! I got two dinosaurs!"

pages.text:
咘咘把一个恐龙贴纸贴在自己的手背上，然后举起另一个，踮着脚尖贴在爸爸的手上。
「一个给咘咘，一个给爸爸！因为爸爸今天也很棒！」
爸爸看着手上的小恐龙贴纸，鼻子一酸，紧紧抱住了咘咘。
pages.text_en:
Bubu stuck one dinosaur sticker on the back of her own hand, then held up the other, standing on tiptoes to stick it on Dad's hand.
"One for Bubu, one for Daddy! Because Daddy was great today too!"
Dad looked at the little dinosaur sticker on his hand, felt a lump in his throat, and hugged Bubu tight.

pages.text:
回家的路上，夕阳把一切都染成了金色。咘咘骑在爸爸的肩膀上，手里还紧紧攥着那只贴了恐龙贴纸的小手。
NOMI 走在旁边，尾巴悠悠地晃着。NONO 停在爸爸的头顶，唱着小歌。
「爸爸，下次家长日，你还来吗？」
「当然来。每一次都来。」
pages.text_en:
On the way home, the sunset turned everything golden. Bubu rode on Dad's shoulders, still clutching the little hand with the dinosaur sticker.
NOMI walked alongside, tail swaying gently. NONO perched on Dad's head, singing a little song.
"Daddy, will you come to the next Family Day?"
"Of course. Every single one."

pages.text:
晚上，咘咘躺在小床上，把贴着恐龙贴纸的手举到眼前看了又看。
「恐龙，晚安。爸爸，晚安。幼儿园，晚安。」
她把小手放在枕头旁边，闭上眼睛，嘴角翘着一个小小的微笑。
今天，是最最最棒的一天。
pages.text_en:
At night, Bubu lay in her little bed, holding up the hand with the dinosaur sticker, looking at it again and again.
"Goodnight, dinosaur. Goodnight, Daddy. Goodnight, kindergarten."
She placed her little hand beside her pillow, closed her eyes, with a tiny smile on her lips.
Today was the very, very, very best day.
